items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: A friend of mine whose name was Don Donaldson, he had an orchestra

ctx.x: saw Howard with the horn, and listened to him, and he said, 'Well, you keep it.' So Howard, he starts playing saxophone. He could play, too -- very good.

So it was a toss-up between him and Johnny, you know, who could play the best. But Johnny had a different kind of tone, a different kind of sound. Now, you could hear the two of them play the same thing, but there was a difference in Johnny's playing. And it was in the tone, you know. But the two of them together, they were really something else. A friend of mine whose name was Don Donaldson, he had an orchestra, and both of them were in the band. They used to rehearse at Don's house -- Don was a piano player.…
